import { useMessage } from '@src/utils/useMessage';
import { disableBackendGroupSubscription } from '@src/api/bot/group-subscription-disable';
import { createBackendRequestContext } from '@src/api/bot/context';
import { enableSubscription } from '@src/response-apps/groupSubscription/app';
import { selects } from '@src/response/config';
import { FormatGui } from '@src/utils/messageHelper';
import { Format, onResponse } from 'alemonjs';

type SubscriptionAction = 'enable' | 'disable';

const getAction = (messageText: string): SubscriptionAction | null => {
  const text = messageText.trim().replace(/^[!！/#＃]/, '');

  if (text === '开启群订阅') {
    return 'enable';
  }
  if (text === '关闭群订阅') {
    return 'disable';
  }

  return null;
};

export default onResponse(selects, async e => {
  const [message] = useMessage();
  const bid = e.UserId;
  const isPrivate = e.isPrivate ?? false;
  const action = getAction(e.MessageText ?? '');

  if (!action) {
    return;
  }

  const md = Format.createMarkdown();

  if (isPrivate || !e.ChannelId) {
    md.addText('请在需要接收通知的群内使用此功能。');
    void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '我的设置', content: md }));

    return;
  }

  const userId = Number(e.uid);

  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(userId) || userId <= 0) {
    md.addText('未找到玩家存档，请先踏入仙途。');
    void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '我的设置', content: md }));

    return;
  }

  if (action === 'enable') {
    const result = await enableSubscription(
      bid,
      userId,
      String(e.Platform ?? ''),
      String(e.ChannelId),
      e.BotId,
      e.Target?.scope === 'channel' || e.SpaceId?.startsWith('GUILD:') ? 'channel' : 'group',
      createBackendRequestContext(e)
    );

    md.addText(result.switched ? '已将订阅群切换至本群。' : '已在本群开启通知订阅。');
    md.addNewline();
    md.addText('后续通知优先在本群 @ 你；群权限关闭时保留订阅，恢复授权后自动恢复。');
    md.addNewline();
    md.addText('通知均可通过 /我的通知 回看；开启订阅不代表平台已允许主动发言。');
  } else if (action === 'disable') {
    const disabled = await disableBackendGroupSubscription(bid, userId, createBackendRequestContext(e));

    md.addText(disabled ? '已关闭群通知订阅。' : '你当前未开启群通知订阅。');
  }

  void message.send(
    FormatGui({
      isPrivate,
      bid,
      mention: false,
      title: '我的设置',
      content: md,
      footer: [{ label: '返回我的设置', command: '/我的设置' }]
    })
  );
});
